# SYNTHETIC JOB DESCRIPTION 04 — Junior Data & Business Analyst
# Label: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE (NOT A REAL JOB POSTING)

Job Title: Associate Data Analyst (Fresher)
Company: RetailMetrics Analytics Group
Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India (Hybrid)
Compensation: ₹5.5 LPA - ₹8.0 LPA

Role Description:
RetailMetrics partners with leading global consumer brands to transform raw transactional data into actionable commercial insights. We are looking for entry-level data analysts with sharp analytical reasoning, SQL expertise, and dashboarding abilities.

Key Deliverables:
• Query, clean, and aggregate multi-million record transactional datasets using PostgreSQL and Snowflake.
• Develop interactive business intelligence reports and KPI dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
• Write Python automation scripts (Pandas, NumPy) to streamline weekly executive ETL pipelines.
• Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) and synthesize findings into concise stakeholder decks.

Candidate Requirements:
• Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or Economics.
• Strong practical proficiency in SQL (Joins, Window Functions, CTEs, Aggregations).
• Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation using Pandas and NumPy.
• Demonstrated ability building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas).

Desirable Skills:
• Understanding of statistical hypothesis testing and A/B test analysis.
• Exposure to Git and cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake).
• Good communication skills to present findings to non-technical partners.
